It measures recurrence and divergence without assuming that repetition proves cause or destiny. Measurement methods Each annual record identifies the March equinox UTC instant, its Pattern Calendar position, the Year Gate (Moon 1 · Day 1 = April 17 of each year), the Passage duration between them, and the approximate lunar phase at the equinox. Offsets are direct measurements. Symbolic layers (Week Gate, Archetype) are clearly labelled. Recurrence scores expose every component dimension; no unexplained index is produced. docs.b: Theory navigation ▾ Part II · Observation Witness Record the event before the explanation becomes the event. Witness is the discipline of preserving what was perceived, when it was perceived, under what conditions, and by whom. It does not eliminate interpretation. It prevents interpretation from silently replacing the record. Open Equation 2 Study the Layers Use the Protocol Back to Operators W A witness record is strongest when it distinguishes direct observation, memory, interpretation, inference, and claim. Plain Language What Witness Means Direct observation is not interpretation Witness begins with what was directly seen, heard, felt, measured, or recorded before any theory explains it. Timing and conditions matter A record must retain when the event happened and what conditions shaped the observation at that time. Who observes shapes what is seen The witness is part of the field, so perspective, location, tools, and attention must be named rather than assumed away. Witness records support revision Preserved records make later correction possible because the original event remains available beside newer explanations. Practice The Witness Protocol 1 · Name the time and place Locate the event before drawing any meaning from it. 2 · Name what was directly perceived Record only what entered perception, measurement, or immediate trace. 3 · Separate memory from fresh perception Keep prior knowledge and current observation in distinct entries. 4 · Name interpretations as interpretations Inference may follow, but it must stay labeled as inference. 5 · Preserve the record unchanged Append correction later instead of overwriting the original witness entry. Key Takeaway Keep the event and the explanation distinct. A witness record cannot be revised by the explanation that came later. The event and its interpretation remain separate entries.
